relations.text: 個別化mRNAがんワクチンmRNA-4157を共同開発し、費用と損益を世界で等分する
relations.text_en: Collaborates with Merck on mRNA-4157 and shares costs and any profits and losses worldwide equally

source.label: Moderna 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Pursuant to the PCV Agreement, we and Merck will collaborate on further development and commercialization of mRNA-4157, and we will share costs and any profits and losses worldwide related to mRNA-4157 equally.

companies.name: バーテックス・ファーマシューティカルズ

relations.text: 嚢胞性線維症向けmRNA-3692(VX-522)でバーテックスと協業している
relations.text_en: Collaborates with Vertex on the cystic fibrosis candidate mRNA-3692/VX-522

source.label: Moderna 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: We are collaborating with Vertex on our CF candidate, mRNA-3692/VX-522, which is designed to treat the underlying cause of CF by enabling cells in the lungs to produce functional CFTR protein for the treatment of the over 5,000 patients who do not produce any modulator-responsive CFTR protein.

relations.text: 2026年1月にmRNA-3927の最終段階の開発と商業化に向けた提携を結んだ
relations.text_en: In January 2026, entered into a strategic collaboration with Recordati to advance mRNA-3927

source.label: Moderna 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In January 2026, we entered into a strategic collaboration with Recordati, an international pharmaceutical group, to advance mRNA-3927 through the final stages of clinical development and, if approved, global commercialization.

relations.text: mRNA-4203をイマティクスと共同で開発している
relations.text_en: Develops mRNA-4203 in collaboration with Immatics

source.label: Moderna 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: mRNA-4203 is being developed in collaboration with Immatics. 18 Table of Contents Intismeran autogene (mRNA-4157) As tumors grow, they acquire mutations which may lead to the creation of new protein segments (neoantigens) that can be presented on human leukocyte antigen (HLA) molecules in the tumor and recognized as non-self by T cells.

relations.text: 2023年初めからAIの活用を共同で進める取り組みを始めた
relations.text_en: Began a collaboration with OpenAI in early 2023 to co-innovate on AI

source.label: Moderna 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In early 2023, we began a collaboration with OpenAI to co-innovate with a shared vision of AI’s transformative potential in the future of business and healthcare.
